message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, I'm Brad. I'm one of two AI scheduling assistants, and my partner is Alison. Our task is to schedule a 30-minute meeting for the four partners of Hale & Raman LLP next week, which is November 16-20, 2026. The partners are Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto and David Okafor.

I can access the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor, while Alison can access the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. We communicate through a shared workspace, and I see Alison has already started the process. She's identified a number of 30-minute slots when Priya Raman and Marcus Hale are both free. My task now is to check those slots against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor.

Here are the slots Alison has proposed:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

I'll start by reading the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor to see their availability for next week. Then I'll compare their schedules with the slots Alison has provided to find one that works for all four partners. Once I've found a time, I'll post it to our shared workspace for Alison.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
